notes: abs_err = 1 - winning-outcome price at that horizon; lower = market prices the winner earlier.
winner price = raw trades.price where outcome_index=winning_outcome_index (source-agnostic; no token-id join).
Late convergence (error still high at 24-1h then collapses) flags event/jump-driven resolution — the Stage C event-study targets (e.g. Fed FOMC markets: priced days out vs jump at the meeting?).
Illiquid markets have sparse minute paths; horizons with few trades are noisier.
